title: docs(adr): ADR-0141 — an app may depend on another installed app: declared in manifest.dependencies, checked once before install, co-owning the namespace it shares
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiSy7TyERBjGhY2v7KGu8Gai)_
Fixes #25403

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Docs-only, Tier H (`docs/adr/**`): the PR stays draft and the maintainer merges it. Records the two maintainer rulings on #25403 — B′ (`6369704387`) and the namespace letter A (`6377678758`) — as a new ADR, and makes the three neighbouring records say the same thing.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
新增 ADR-0141,把「应用 B 可以声明依赖应用 A」写成契约:声明沿用 `manifest.dependencies`,引用沿用保存门的依赖闭包;唯一新增的关口是**安装前检查**(依赖已装、版本在范围内,否则拒绝并说明缺什么,填上预留的 `dependency_missing`);声明了依赖且命名空间相同的包,在安装门上与被依赖方**共有命名空间**(单向),对象名唯一检查跨发布物同样生效。卸载保护、升级拦截、拓扑/连带安装、被引用方发布标记、市场版本协商逐项写为推迟项;权限不变。另外三处配套:ADR-0028 D4 改为「未声明依赖不得跨应用引用」;ADR-0019 只加一行交叉引用(原文不改);ADR-0130 加附录,D8 的推迟改为「到市场发布时结束」,并标注它关于 #14488 的那一行已过时。

**为什么改**
你在 #25403 批了 B′ 和命名空间 A。HotCRM 想把 revenue 等模块拆成可以单独安装的包(「而每个包可以独立安装」),今天做不到:安装时没有任何地方检查依赖是否已装,单独发布的模块还会因为共用 `crm` 命名空间被安装门拒绝。这份 ADR 定下契约,运行时卡在它合并后再切。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
只改文档,不动代码和 schema。业务上的代价写进了 ADR:卸载或升级被依赖的应用暂时不拦(推迟项),管理员可能把依赖方晾在那里;单独发布的模块和主应用各有版本号,ADR-0130 在同一发布物内消除的版本矩阵会在跨发布物时回来,只靠声明的版本范围约束。回滚:撤销本 PR 的合并即可,没有任何运行时状态。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
读 ADR 里「Open questions for the maintainer's merge decision」十条（前四条定机制：同一发布物内的依赖算已装；只在安装动作时检查、开机重注册不检查；命名空间共有关系由依赖方单向声明，门禁不论哪一方后注册都按这一条声明判定；只认直接声明。五至八条定拒绝的形状：422；版本或范围解析不了即拒绝，与同一道门上协议握手的「警告并放行」相反；每条声明都是必需、`optional` 投影为 false；只判本包自己的声明。第九条：D8 的记录到数组转换让运行时卡比裁决估的 XS–S 大。第十条：对 #14488 裁决前提已被 B′ 移动的读法）。同意就合并，合并即接受；有异议就在 PR 里点出哪一条。

## What changed

D1 declaration and reference (no new mechanism) · D2 the pre-install check (what it judges; 422 + a ledger-registered code + one `dependency_missing` issue per unmet entry; the three install acts it runs at and the three re-registration paths it does not; fail-closed on an unparseable range, the opposite of the handshake beside it) · D3 the five deferred items, each with its interim state and trigger · D4 permissions unchanged, record-level semantics an open section of three questions (incl. the ADR-0086 D4 own-namespace discriminator that D5 dissolves across artifacts) · D5 dependency-declared namespace co-ownership, one-way, D3 uniqueness across co-owners, ADR-0130 D8's deferral now ending at marketplace publishing · D6 what ADR-0028/0019/0130 now say · D7 the first consumer (a HotCRM module shipping alone, revenue first) · D8 the three dependency shapes and the alignment the runtime card owes · a merge-decision list of ten drafter choices (1–4 the mechanism, 5–8 the refusal's shape, 9 the D8 conversion's sizing, 10 the reading of ruling `5645322259`) |

The rest of the record stays Deferred |

No original text edited. The addendum also records, byte-exact, the sentence of ruling `5645322259` whose premise (whole-artifact install only) the B′ ruling moved, while its disposition stands |

## Measurements (at `origin/main` `47af3dde42`)

- **Dispatch assumption "nothing at install reads `manifest.dependencies`"** — holds for checking, fails for ordering by one reader: `resolveArtifactPackageEntries` (`packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`) feeds every declared id to `resolvePluginOrder` as an optional edge and skips an id outside the artifact silently. No install door checks presence or version; `dependency_missing` occurs only in `app-install.zod.ts`, its test and `content/docs/references/system/app-install.mdx` — the only three tracked occurrences (zero producers). Recorded in the ADR's Context and Verification notes; no decision moves.
- **Dispatch assumption "the namespace refusal is `NamespaceConflictError` in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`"** — holds. Gate and throw are `SchemaRegistry.installPackage` / `NamespaceConflictError`; the co-owner set is `ArtifactInstallScope.packageIds` (artifact scope only); `refuseCoOwnedObjectNameCollision` reads the same set and skips non-co-owners by design, which is why D5's one added source makes both halves of the ADR-0130 D3 pair follow. The line numbers the HotCRM input and the ruling cite have moved; the ADR cites symbols.
- **Three dependency shapes, not two**: the manifest record, the marketplace `PackageDependencySchema` array, and a third — `AppManifestSchema.dependencies`, bare ids with no range, in the same file as `dependency_missing`, no reader outside `packages/spec`. `os package publish` snapshots the record shape into `manifest_json`, whose declared schema is the array; the control-plane side lives in `objectstack-ai/cloud` and is not measured.
- **ADR number**: `0136` and `0140` belong to proposals that never landed (PR #18480 closed 2026-09-18, superseded by the North Star; PR #25618 withdrawn 2026-10-24 by the maintainer's ruling in session); no landed record or open PR carries either number. This record is `0141`.
- **In-repo declaring population**: one manifest, `examples/app-multi-package` (orders → core, same artifact) — why D2 counts a co-delivered dependency as present.

`check-adr-links` (+ `--self-test`), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (+ `--self-test`; 2446 anchors across 143 records resolve), `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.

The record was re-drafted at `247fe2fa` at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with effort xhigh, on the owner's order that ADR text runs at that tier (card #25729). Contract review PASS at `247fe2fa` (comment `6392433266`); its five nits landed in `fa733808`.
No changeset: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes

- hotcrm `docs/architecture/module-split-plan.md`, hotcrm#2270 and hotcrm#2271 are cited as the rulings cite them; that repository is not readable from this session.
- Ruling `6369704387` says "`revenue` first per ADR-0130 §1.3(c)"; §1.3(c) names CPQ as the unsellable module. The ADR records revenue-first as HotCRM's own ordering; nothing moves.
- D5's "read from either end" is the drafter's reading of the ruling's "one-way" (who declares and who gains stay one-way; the gate reads the one declared fact whichever package registers second) — needed because a rehydrate that registers the dependent first would otherwise refuse the depended-on app. Merge question 3.
- D4's open section carries the ADR-0086 D4 discriminator question; nothing in-repo was measured to refuse a package's permission set naming another package's object — recorded as open, not decided.
- The ADR's merge-decision list now names all ten drafter choices the contract review enumerated (its D(5)–(10) are items 5–10): 422; fail-closed parse vs `assertProtocolCompat`'s warn-and-admit; required entries / `optional` → false; own entries only; the D8 record-to-array conversion sizing the runtime card beyond XS–S; the reading that ruling `5645322259`'s premise was moved by B′.
